faq.label: Exhibitor FAQ
faq.title: The last questions before you book.
faq.lead: FAQ, form, WhatsApp and appointments work as one system: remove the last objection and make contact easy.

q1.question: How do I book?
q1.answer: Four paths lead to the same file: the qualification form, a quick WhatsApp exchange, a scheduled appointment, or a brochure request to move at your own pace. Start with whichever suits you — the team follows up with a proposal tailored to your project.

q2.question: How are visitors qualified?
q2.answer: The qualification setup is documented per exhibition, and every published figure carries its period and source. The full detail is presented during the commercial exchange.

q3.question: How many visitors are expected?
q3.answer: No figure is published without validation. Attendance is communicated per exhibition, with its period and source, on each edition's page and during the commercial exchange.

q4.question: What does it cost?
q4.answer: Offers are structured in levels — see the Offers page. Pricing depends on the exhibition, the surface and the level you choose; a quoted proposal follows the qualification of your needs.

q5.question: How do I get my leads?
q5.answer: Contacts collected during the exhibition are handed back to you, and their follow-up is part of the before–during–after support described in the method. The exact hand-back process is presented during the commercial exchange.

q6.question: How does stand setup work?
q6.answer: The exhibitor guide and the before–during–after checklist cover preparation, setup and teardown. These documents are released in the resources as soon as their validated versions exist.

q7.question: What support is included?
q7.answer: Support follows the before–during–after method; its exact scope depends on the offer level you choose. The Method and Offers pages describe what each level covers.
